flagNotes: walkable = ground layer, slope <= 50° and a 5 m wide body fits; pocket = walkable cell in a component of < 30 cells (cut off by walls or cliffs, reach with jets)
cover: bit k: wall (solid spanning surface+1..surface+6 m, or terrain >= surface+6) within 6 m in the 45° sector centred on yaw k*45°

model.viewer: mech on walkable ground (slope <= 50°) or a reachable roof (<= 58 m up), eye at surface + 8
model.near: rings <= 44 m: terrain and prisms block, trees do not
model.far: terrain, prisms and trunks block; crowns (ellipsoids) block when exp(-canopyDensity * chord) < canopyBlockT
model.planes: gExp/rExp: all viewers, all rings; gNear/rNear: rings <= 44 m; *GV: only viewers standing on the ground count as seeing (same denominator, so *GV <= the plain plane). 0..255 = fraction of valid viewpoints that see the target
